title: Implement manifest reconciliation and idempotent sync engine
description: Implement the native synchronization loop. Support bounded pages/runs, retry classification, exponential backoff with jitter, Retry-After, cancellation, and crash-safe resumption.
design: Legacy clients may still write Firestore during the grace release, so do not rely solely on an incremental change log. A successful repeated create/update/delete must converge without duplicates. Network/auth/server failures retain local state. Do not run sync for a signed-out or different UID.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic tests cover initial hydration, offline create/update/delete, reconnect, duplicate retry, crash/restart, legacy remote edit/delete, pagination, 409, 401, 429, transient 5xx, clean remote deletion, dirty remote deletion, and account switching; all cases converge or produce an explicit preserved conflict without silent loss.

Real wiring (db/sync.ts) only instantiates the 'workout' adapter — profile/pushupChallenge adapters are the same shape over db/singleton-repository.ts's new SingletonSyncOps (removeClean/markConflict) but aren't wired yet; 'injury' has no local table at all (bead .3 only stored injuries embedded in the profile doc, but shared/api-contract.ts's manifest/pull treat injury as its own syncableKind) — that's schema debt for whoever picks up injuries sync, needs its own db table + adapter, not just wiring. Also found and fixed two real bugs while writing this: db/workouts.ts's update()/softDelete() and db/singleton-repository.ts's upsert() were defaulting baseVersion to null instead of the row's last-known server_version when the caller didn't pass meta explicitly — every second local edit after a sync would have falsely 409'd against the real API. Fixed in the same commit-worth of changes (not yet committed).
close_reason: Engine complete and tested (13/13 scenarios, db/sync-engine.test.ts); depends on db/workouts.ts's repository functions (all implemented, tested, used extensively by this bead's own tests) not on bead .2's one remaining line (widget/Wear snapshot derivation, which sync-engine.ts never touches). title: Implement durable outbox, sync metadata, and conflict persistence

  new SignJWT({ scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datastore' })
    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: 'RS256' })
    .setIssuer(CLIENT_EMAIL).setAudience('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token')
    .setIssuedAt().setExpirationTime('1h')
    .sign(await importPKCS8(PRIVATE_KEY.replace(/\\n/g, '\n'), 'RS256'))
  POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token
    grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion=<jwt>
